description: Leading eigenvalues of the lid-driven cavity at Re = 3600 (lx1 = 12), direct problem. The flow is linearly stable: a real eigenvalue -0.01679 and a complex pair -0.04198 +- 0.77165 i. The values depend on the resolution (table in the family README); the tolerance of 1e-4 is below the change between lx1 = 10 and 12.

pair_omega.note: Imaginary part of the second row; the file lists one member of the conjugate pair.
